name: Rebuild a whole page as Shopify theme sections with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Rebuild a whole page as Shopify sections
MiroMiro rebuilds every section of the page as a Shopify Online Store 2.0 section (`.liquid`), and n8n zips them.

In Shopify: *Online Store > Themes > Edit code > sections*, add each file, then add the sections to a page in the theme editor.

10 credits per section; repeat calls within 24h are free.

**Setup (1 minute)**
1. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
2. Open any MiroMiro node > Credential > Create new, paste the key.
3. Change the website in **Settings**, then click **Execute workflow**.
